text.description_html:
4 1/2" x 4 1/2" x Square Corners Commercial Door Hinge

Extra Heavy Duty stainless steel commercial door hinge with 4 ball bearings and Non-Rising Removable Pin. Conforms to ANSI A5111

Specifications: for Global CSH4545BB-32D Stainless Steel Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.180" (Extra Heavy Duty)
  • 4 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Non-Rising Hinge Pin
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Stainless Steel Hinge Pin
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/2"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Conforms to ANSI A5111

Package with Stainless Steel machine screws and wood screws. For use with heavy metal or wood doors.

*Sold Individually
